reason: I check Google and Trustpilot before I ring anyone, and there's nothing to check here: no reviews, no past clients, no UK office. Not paying upfront is nice, but I'd still be giving my time to a company in Kuwait I can't vet, and I don't have time for calls and back-and-forth that might go nowhere.
objection: Zero reviews and no work to look at. If it goes wrong, who do I chase, and how many evenings do I lose going back and forth on WhatsApp across time zones?
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a few genuine Google or Trustpilot reviews from other Manchester small businesses, plus live sites they've actually built that I can click through.
